_notes: 1. Vulgate Ps 143=思高 Ps 144; Vg 144=思高 145; Vg 145=思高 146; Vg 146+147=思高 147 (Vg 146:1-11=思高 147:1-11, Vg 147:1-9=思高 147:12-20); Vg 148=思高 148. 2. 146:1 ('Laudáte Dóminum quóniam bonus est psalmus'): The 思高 Ps 147:1 begins with 亚肋路亚 and covers the incipit; this is the first verse after the doxological opening of Vulgate Ps 146. Rendered following 思高 147:1 text. 3. 148:5 second hemistich: 思高 reads '他一命令，它们便受了造' — adapted as '他一宣旨，它们便有了存在' to cover both 'mandávit' and 'creáta sunt'; 思高 v.5 text: '因为上主一命，它们立刻受造.' Second half uses 思高 148:5 ('他颁布的规律，永不变更' is v.6 — v.5 only has one clause). Second hemistich translated from Latin directly as '他一宣旨，它们便有了存在'. 4. Vulgate 143:12 split into two sub-verses (12a filii / 12b filiæ); 思高 144:12 treats both in one verse — split applied per breviary structure. 5. 思高 147:8b ('he makes grass grow on the hills') is split across 146:8a and 8b; 146:8b second clause ('herbam servitúti hóminum') not in 思高 verbatim — rendered as '也生出供人使用的百草' (paraphrase from Latin). 6. 146:11 second hemistich: 思高 147:11 reads only '信赖他慈爱的人' without a predicate — added '方能蒙他悦纳' to match Latin 'beneplácitum erit ei'.
